about: Request unit PR 2 (feat/eng-request-settled-fns, NUMBER PENDING): the runtime lane's request reader reads a timeframe written as a call to the script's own function (an expression body, or `x = '<text>'` + one `if` chain of `x := '<text>'`), through a name bound once to such a call, and the chart's own extended-session ticker at the chart's own D on a daily chart; anything else is refused by name, and the plot lane reads as before. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: the runtime lane's reach reads no call
mutants.from: const REQUEST_TF_REACH = Object.freeze({ hops: TF_READ_HOPS, calls: true })
mutants.to: const REQUEST_TF_REACH = Object.freeze({ hops: TF_READ_HOPS, calls: false })

mutants.mutant: the runtime lane does not hand its resolvers the script's functions
mutants.from: const settledFunctions = { get: (name) => settledFunctionNamed(name), alias: (name) => settledAliasNamed(name) }
mutants.to: const settledFunctions = { get: () => null, alias: () => null }

mutants.mutant: a chain with no `else` is settled (its value where no arm runs is not one answer)
mutants.from: if (chain.branches[chain.branches.length - 1].condToks !== null) return refuse('its `if` chain has no `else`')
mutants.to: if (false) return refuse('its `if` chain has no `else`')

mutants.mutant: an arm that writes something other than text is taken
mutants.from: if (!isText(value)) return refuse(`an arm writes \`${name}\` something other than text written into the script`)
mutants.to: if (false) return refuse(`an arm writes \`${name}\` something other than text written into the script`)

mutants.mutant: a name the script reassigns is read as the call it was first bound to
the extended-session own ticker is read at any timeframe (not only the chart's own D)
the plot lane reads the extended-session own ticker too (the confinement is gone)
